clues: This is the largest city of Myanmar, in the warm south east of Asia. It is the chief trade heart of that whole land.
Rain pours down here from May through October, in a long wet spell. Then a dry spell runs from November through April, with scant rain.
This city served as the capital of its land until 2006. Then the army rulers moved that work to a new built capital in the north.
At the heart of its old trade core stands a pagoda said to be more than two thousand years old. Old streets ring it, still whole from a past age.
A grand gold pagoda crowns this city, held most holy by its faith. It is the most famed shrine of its kind in the whole land.
